files.name: motion-prompt-141.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Pixelate" (ピクセレート), one of the names in "Motion graphics moves, part 2".
Motion Prompt #141

What it is: Turns into coarse blocks, then switches
What the sample shows: The picture turns into coarser and coarser blocks, switches at the coarsest point, then sharpens again.
Spec:
- Field scene → city scene → field, 2.35 s each. At 0.2–1.9 s (1.7 s) the block size steps up and back down through 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 11, 15, 20, 27 and 36 px (coarsest at the midpoint, 1.05 s).
- The first half shows the old scene and the second half the new one; the swap happens at the coarsest step.
- Method: shrink the frame to width ÷ block size with smoothing on, then scale it back up with smoothing off.
When to use it: Use it for game-like, retro or digital scene changes, or to blur something out as the scene switches.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/141.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/motion2.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
